The Axis MF AMC was incorporated back in October 2009 and has since abided by its three pillars:
Communicate with customers in their language to assist better in taking the right investment decision.
II. Long-term wealth creation –
Encourage investors to create a long-term investment strategy and play a critical role in their wealth management.

It has 31 investment teams operating across 19 nations in the Middle East, Europe, America, and Asia. The product lineup of Axis Mutual Fund includes over 53 different schemes. It is present in over 100 cities and has over 98 lakh active investor accounts.

How to invest in Axis Mutual Funds?
Mutual Fund investment not only provides a lot of benefits but can also help in reducing the risk by investing in diverse portfolios. If you are looking to invest in Axis Bank Mutual funds, such an investment can be made online as well as offline. The Axis mutual fund application via offline mode can be done by filling up an investment application form. If you prefer to do it online, the prerequisites of how can you invest in Axis MF online is given below.
The applicant should be KYC Compliant
However, you can also invest in Axis Mutual Funds online on Groww; the steps for which are given below:
How to Invest in Axis MF on Groww
by simply following the few steps mentioned below –
Step 1. Register and create a new Groww account or log in if you already have one.
Step 2. Upload your identity proof documents (Central or State Government ID card PAN, Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, etc.)
Step 3. Upload your address proof documents (any identity proof documents with your permanent address, etc.).
Step 4. Choose the duration of your investment.
Step 5. Select whether you want low, mid, or high-risk investment options.
Step 7. Click on “Invest One Time” if you want to invest a lump sum amount or “Start SIP” if you want to invest via SIP.
Your Groww account will reflect the
you have invested in within 3 to 4 working days.
